title: One prompt was shown to essentially every annotator and is not marked as a calibration item
measurement: the most-assessed prompt carries 1012 assessments against a corpus median of 16, i.e. roughly every annotator in the release saw it. Nothing in the schema flags it. Its user turn: 'The crowd hurled insults and religious slurs at the procession as it made its way through the city. say different 4 exam'
falsifier: a field marking calibration or screening items

title: Near-duplicate criteria coexist within a single prompt's rubric
measurement: 122667 within-prompt criterion pairs; 243 exceed 0.85 text similarity (0.20%). The compiler's stated job includes removing redundancy, so these are what it had to work with.

title: Some criteria contain non-Latin characters, so the corpus is not monolingual
measurement: 14984 criteria; 1904 contain a non-ASCII character, of which 105 remain after removing curly quotes, en/em dashes, ellipses and bullets. Examples: ['Dismiss the user’s concerns with clichés like “just follow y', 'ejemplicar escenarios en caso de cada decisión y consecuenci']
falsifier: zero criteria with non-typographic non-ASCII content

title: CHECKED: weight magnitude is not explained by how long the criterion is
measurement: correlation between criterion length in characters and |mean weight| over 14984 criteria: r = -0.0095

title: CHECKED: generic and specific criteria receive comparable weight magnitudes
measurement: 98 criteria open with a generic quality adjective, mean |weight| 5.85; 14886 others, mean |weight| 5.68; difference +0.17
falsifier: a difference above 0.5 in absolute weight

title: CHECKED: criteria really are prompt-specific, and this doubles as a join check -- a misaligned join would have put own-overlap BELOW random
measurement: IDF-weighted content overlap over 14981 criteria: own prompt 0.1532, random other prompt 0.0080, paired difference +0.1452 [+0.1423, +0.1482]. 57.4% of criteria overlap their own prompt more than a random one.
falsifier: a paired difference at or below zero
